sourceReceipt.visualReview: Both pages rendered to PNG and visually inspected against the extracted article structure.
sourceReceipt.runtimeVerification: The artifact and extraction digests were recomputed from the participant-held source during this review. The source files remain outside the public repository.

contractRole: Co-versioned regression contract. It detects drift from the reviewed records but is not an independent authority; fresh read-only review occurs outside the evaluator.
reviewHistory: Two-page text extraction and visual-render review performed on 2026-07-16.
Fresh read-only adversarial judges iteratively tested the source record and evaluator; outcomes are documented in the public handoff.
scope: Mission-relevant project facts, attributed interpretations, collective labor, route chronology, and public-use boundaries from the two-page newspaper article.
copyrightBoundary: The fixture stores bounded propositions and locators, not the article text or PDF.

identityNormalization.rule: Source-level observations retain James Burkart or the source's Burkart form; current portfolio projections may use Jamie while disclosing the normalization when the distinction matters.
